sections.title: Welcome to Control and Coordination
learning_goals: Understand the fundamental concepts of control and coordination in living organisms.

sections.title: What You'll Learn Today
learning_goals: Define control and coordination and their importance.
Differentiate between nervous and endocrine systems in animals.
Explain the structure and function of neurons and the nervous system.
Describe reflex actions and the reflex arc.
Identify the main parts and functions of the human brain.
Understand coordination and tropic movements in plants.
Explore hormonal control in animals and the endocrine system.
Learn about different plant hormones and their roles.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Summary of learning objectives presented as bullet points with avatar.

sections.title: Introduction to Control and Coordination
learning_goals: Define control and coordination in the context of living organisms.
Explain why coordination is essential for survival.
Identify key terms related to control and coordination.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Conceptual explanation and definitions, best presented with text and avatar.

sections.title: Animal Control Systems: Nervous and Endocrine
learning_goals: Distinguish between the nervous system and the endocrine system in animals.
Understand the primary roles of each system in maintaining coordination.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Introducing two distinct systems, can be shown with comparative text and avatar.

sections.title: The Nervous System: Neurons and Nerve Impulses
learning_goals: Describe the basic structure of a neuron.
Explain how nerve impulses are transmitted.
Differentiate between voluntary and involuntary actions.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Visualizing neuron structure and nerve impulse transmission can be effectively animated with Manim.

sections.title: Reflex Actions and the Reflex Arc
learning_goals: Define reflex action and its importance.
Trace the pathway of a nerve impulse in a reflex arc.
Identify the components of a reflex arc.
sections.renderer_reasoning: The process of a reflex arc, involving multiple components and a pathway, is well-suited for Manim animation.

sections.title: The Human Brain: Structure and Functions
learning_goals: Identify the major parts of the human brain (fore-brain, mid-brain, hind-brain).
Describe the primary functions of each brain region.
Understand how the brain coordinates various body activities.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Illustrating the complex structure of the brain and its distinct regions with labels and functional overlays is ideal for Manim.

sections.title: Plant Coordination: Tropic Movements
learning_goals: Define tropic movements in plants.
Identify different types of tropic movements (e.g., phototropism, geotropism).
Explain how plants respond to various stimuli.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Visualizing plant growth and movement in response to stimuli (like light or gravity) is best done with real-world video footage or time-lapse animations.

sections.title: Hormonal Control in Animals: The Endocrine System
learning_goals: Understand the role of hormones in animal coordination.
Identify major endocrine glands and the hormones they produce.
Explain the function of key hormones like insulin.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Illustrating the locations of endocrine glands and their hormonal pathways can be clearly shown with Manim diagrams.

sections.title: Plant Hormones and Their Functions
learning_goals: List the main types of plant hormones (auxin, gibberellin, cytokinins, abscisic acid).
Describe the specific functions of each plant hormone.
Understand how plant hormones regulate growth and development.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Demonstrating the effects of plant hormones on growth, flowering, and fruit development is best visualized through video or time-lapse animations.

sections.title: Test Your Knowledge!
learning_goals: Assess understanding of control and coordination concepts.
Reinforce key definitions and processes.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Standard quiz format with questions and answers presented as flashcards.

sections.title: Key Takeaways
learning_goals: Review the most important concepts from the lesson.
Consolidate understanding of control and coordination.

learning_goals: Summarize the entire lesson on control and coordination.
Reinforce the interconnectedness of different systems.
